comping 的重點是留白。這個字指的是節奏組成員即時決定和弦的排列、節奏與密: The point of comping is leaving space. The word means that members of the rhythm section decide on the spot how to space the chord, and with what rhythm and density: the same chord can be played by the piano as a long note, cut into two, or brought in only in the second half of the bar. These choices are not decoration but a response to the soloist. The soloist finishes a phrase and the piano catches it with a chordal motif; the soloist stops and the piano fills a little space; the soloist stretches the sentence out and the piano backs off. So comping is a conversation in real time, where frequency matters more than the number of notes.
comping：即時決定和弦的排列、節奏與密度，留白給獨奏: comping: deciding the spacing, rhythm and density of chords on the spot, leaving space for the solo
也因為小編制可以在現場即時調整，它常被用來伴奏歌手：歌手改變句子的長度或進入的位: Because a small group can adjust on the spot, it is also often used to accompany singers: the singer changes the length of a phrase or where it comes in, and the band has to follow in the same breath. This work depends on listening even more than playing pure instrumental music, because the words and the breathing are themselves part of the time.
以 ride cymbal 維持連續的擺動，hi-hat 標出第二、第四拍；用: Keeps a continuous swing on the ride cymbal and marks beats two and four on the hi-hat; answers the soloist with fills and accents
先聽 ride cymbal 的擺動，再確認低音提琴的每一拍是否和它對齊。這兩層: Listen to the swing of the ride cymbal first, then check whether every beat of the double bass lines up with it. Once these two layers separate, the whole sense of time goes slack.
前線與節奏組的關係是協商，不是服從。小編制沒有指揮，獨奏者不能只盯著自己的譜。獨: The relation between the front line and the rhythm section is negotiation, not obedience. A small group has no conductor, and the soloist cannot just stare at their own part. The soloist changes the length, density and volume of phrases and the rhythm section follows; conversely, the drummer can signal with a fill or an accent that a section is changing, the bass player can push the harmony in a new direction with one semitone, and the piano can hint at tension with a dissonant note. These signals are different every night; rehearsal can settle the rough frame but not each breath.
即興在和聲進行與曲式之內發生。和弦的順序是共同法律，樂手可以改變節奏、密度、音色: Improvisation happens inside the progression and the form. The order of chords is shared law; players may change rhythm, density, timbre and phrase length, but they may not leave the others not knowing where they are. Freedom comes from knowing the frame, not from abandoning it.
即興就是完全自由，想做什麼都可以。: Improvisation means complete freedom; you can do anything you like.
和搖滾樂團的差別在低音的來源。搖滾樂團的大鼓與電貝斯鎖在同一個拍點上，靠擴音製造: The difference from a rock band is where the bass comes from. In a rock band the bass drum and the electric bass lock to the same beat and sound pressure is made by amplification; in a small group the double bass walks, changing note on every beat and joining root, third and fifth into a line. Both are combinations of about four players, but one is driven by a fixed rhythmic lock and the other by a chord progression.
在小編制裡，鼓手是對話者。穩定的脈動只是起點，鼓手要用 fill、重音與音色變化: In a small group the drummer is an interlocutor. A steady pulse is only the starting point; the drummer uses fills, accents and changes of timbre to signal sections, answer the soloist, and push the music's tension up or let it down. Treat the drums as a metronome and the whole band becomes a backing track.
小編制出現在爵士俱樂部、酒吧、餐廳、婚禮、音樂節與學校社團。它的曲目有兩條來源：: Small groups play in jazz clubs, bars, restaurants, weddings, festivals and school clubs. Their repertoire has two sources: standards, played so often that they have become a common language, and the players' own compositions. Weddings and banquets need danceable repertoire at a controllable volume; festivals and clubs allow longer solos and more experimental passages.
小編制就是「人數比較少的大樂團」，所以不需要編曲。: A small group is just a big band with fewer people, so it needs no arrangement.
小編制的編制表看起來像一份樂器清單，實際上是把「一個鼓手的工作」拆給節奏組的三個: A small group's line-up table looks like a list of instruments, but it is really the work of one drummer split among three people in the rhythm section. The drum set handles pulse and timbre, the double bass handles the weight of each beat and the harmonic root, the piano or guitar handles when the harmony appears; the front line handles melody and conversation.
小編制的編曲在於「框架」而不是「每一拍」：主題的齊奏、和聲的配置、段落的順序是安: A small group's arranging is about the frame, not every beat: the unison statement of the theme, the voicing of the harmony and the order of sections are planned, while the improvised passages are left for the players to negotiate. It is not unarranged; it scatters the arranging decisions into the performance itself.
找現場錄音而不是錄音室版本，小編制的價值有一大半在於當下的協商。: Look for live recordings rather than studio versions; a good part of a small group's value is in the negotiation of the moment.
最常被混為一談的是爵士大樂團。兩者都用鼓、低音提琴與鋼琴撐節奏，但大樂團的管樂分: The one most often confused with it is the big band. Both use drums, double bass and piano to carry the rhythm, but a big band's horns are divided into three blocks reading parts, and improvisation happens only in designated solo sections; a small group's front line is usually only one to three horns, the unison theme is short, and the rest is improvisation. A big band's time is fixed by the arrangement; a small group's time is negotiated on the spot between the soloist and the rhythm section.
比較第一次與最後一次的主題齊奏：速度、和聲、音量、裝飾音通常都不一樣。: Compare the first and last statement of the theme: tempo, harmony, volume and ornaments are usually all different.
注意鋼琴什麼時候「不彈」。comping 的功力往往在空白處，而不是在音符多的地: Notice when the piano does not play. The skill of comping often lies in the blank spaces rather than where the notes are many.
演出結構上，小編制依靠「循環」而不是「段落」，最常見的是 head–solos–: In performance structure a small group relies on the cycle rather than the section, most commonly head–solos–head: the whole group states the theme, then each player takes turns improvising over the fixed progression, and finally they return to the theme. The underlying form is still sectional, though: the progression is the shared law, most often the twelve-bar blues and the thirty-two-bar song form (AABA). Players remember the order of the chords and how long each chord lasts, not a fixed accompaniment part. The same theme can be reharmonised, retempoed or re-densified on the last statement, and this returning to the theme but not quite the same is how this line-up ends a piece.
為什麼是這些樂器，而不是別的？低音提琴的撥奏（pizzicato）在沒有擴音的空: Why these instruments and not others? The double bass's pizzicato carries through the drums in a room with no amplification without covering the piano's midrange; the piano can give harmony and rhythm at once, and its left hand does not have to fight the bass for the same place; the guitar buys space with its timbre and the position of its amplifier. This combination formed in the years before the PA, when volume could only come from the instruments' own projection, which is why the line-up cannot be large. Once the electric organ, electric guitar and electric bass arrived, the same duties could be done by different instruments, and the line-up became a set of duties rather than a fixed list of instrument names.
爵士小編制（Jazz Combo）— 三到六人、由節奏組撐住時間、前線與節奏組即: Jazz Combo — a small jazz line-up of three to six players, with the rhythm section holding the time and the front line negotiating with it in real time. Ensembles and instrumentation by Next Door Sound Weavers.
爵士小編制（jazz combo）通常由三到六名樂手組成，分成節奏組（rhyth: A jazz combo usually has three to six players, divided into a rhythm section and a front line. The problem it has to solve is concrete: with no conductor and no score that writes down every beat, how a group of people can improvise at the same time and still be at the same point in time.
獨奏時，聽節奏組是機械地重複，還是真的在回應獨奏者的句子。: When someone solos, listen to whether the rhythm section is repeating mechanically or really answering the soloist's sentences.
節奏組不是伴奏，而是三個人合起來才等於一個完整的時間感。鼓的 ride cymb: The rhythm section is not accompaniment; it is three people together making one complete sense of time. The drums' ride cymbal supplies a continuous swing, its ding-da-ding-da pattern giving the music forward momentum; the hi-hat steps out shorter sounds on beats two and four, marking the skeleton of the swing. The double bass walks, one note per beat, joining the chord's root, third and fifth and the passing tones into a line. The piano or guitar comps — not playing the chord full but placing it selectively, in the places that will affect the soloist. Only with these layers together does the time feel held up, rather than dragged along by one instrument.
與阿拉伯塔赫特相比，差別在即興的骨架。爵士的骨架是一組和弦進行（chord ch: Compared with the Arab takht, the difference is the skeleton for improvisation. Jazz's skeleton is a set of chord changes, and players can change melody and rhythm over the same progression; the takht's skeleton is a single maqām mode, with no chords to match, and everyone ornaments the same melody at different densities.
薩克斯風、小號、長號等（front line）: Saxophone, trumpet, trombone and so on (front line)
調音與記譜也影響聲音。低音提琴與電貝斯都以低音譜表記譜，實際發音比譜面低一個八度: Tuning and notation affect the sound too. The double bass and the electric bass are both written in bass clef and sound an octave below the page; among the horns, the saxophone and the trumpet are transposing instruments, and a B-flat saxophone and trumpet read different pitches from the piano (the trombone is written at concert pitch). For the same chord, each player has a different note name in their head, but what is heard must match. This same result, different notation is one of the most time-consuming parts of a small group's rehearsal, and the reason players in a small group have to know what the others are doing rather than reading only their own line.
走 walking bass，每拍一個音，把根音、三度、五度與經過音連成一條線，: Walks, one note per beat, joining root, third and fifth and the passing tones into a line while fixing the time
音量平衡則取決於場合。小空間裡，鼓可能只用鼓刷（brushes）或控制在小音量；: Volume balance depends on the occasion. In a small room the drums may use brushes only or be kept quiet; in a large room the double bass and the piano need microphones. The advantage of a small group is that it can shrink or expand: the same combination is one thing in a restaurant and another on a festival stage.
顫音琴與電風琴可取代或補強鋼琴的音色與和聲層；打擊樂則補強節奏與音色層: Vibraphone and electric organ can replace or reinforce the piano's colour and harmonic layer; percussion reinforces the rhythm and colour layer
鼓手的工作就是打拍子，愈穩愈好。: The drummer's job is to keep time, and the steadier the better.
